explanation: From main: vite.config.ts gates VitePWA on VITE_SERVICE_WORKER (selfDestroying when unset, full Workbox config kept for opt-in); deploy:cf and deploy:cf:dry run build instead of deploy:dist, so precompress is now Apache-only; verify_deploy treats the app sidecar yardstick as optional on the edge model, and the delivery, development, guidance and release docs and catalog describe this. From the mobile pass: index.html keeps the hub bar from shrinking under the beta notice at 320px and puts the phone hub nav on one sideways-scrolling line beside the compare pill.
